Laravel application; expert in: inertiajs/inertia-laravel v2, laravel/fortify v1, laravel/framework v12, laravel/prompts v0, laravel/wayfinder v0, laravel/boost v2, laravel/mcp v0, laravel/pail v1, laravel/pint v1, laravel/sail v1, pestphp/pest v4, phpunit/phpunit v12.

This project has domain-specific skills available. You MUST activate the relevant skill whenever you work in that domain—don't wait until you're stuck.
- `wayfinder-development`: whenever referencing backend routes in frontend components, importing from `@/actions` or `@/routes`, calling Laravel routes from TypeScript, or using Wayfinder route functions.
- `pest-testing`: when writing tests, creating unit/feature tests, adding assertions, testing Livewire/browser behavior, debugging failures, using datasets/mocks, or the user mentions test/spec/TDD/expect/assertion/coverage or needs verification.

You must follow all existing code conventions used in this application. When creating or editing a file, check sibling files for correct structure, approach, and naming. Use descriptive variable/method names; reuse existing components. Stick to existing directory structure; don't create new base folders without approval. Do not change the application's dependencies without approval. Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover that functionality and prove they work. Unit and feature tests are more important. You must only create documentation files if explicitly requested by the user.

Be concise in explanations. Use Laravel Boost MCP tools. Use `list-artisan-commands` when checking Artisan command parameters. Use `get-absolute-url` whenever sharing a project URL. Use `tinker` to execute PHP for debugging or querying Eloquent models; use `database-query` for read-only database access; use `database-schema` before writing migrations/models; use `browser-logs` for recent browser logs, errors, and exceptions.

Search documentation before code changes. ALWAYS use `search-docs` for version-specific Laravel, Inertia, and Pest documentation/examples. It uses installed packages/versions; pass package arrays when known. Use multiple broad, simple, topic-based queries. Do not add package names to queries. Search supports stemming, AND terms, exact quoted phrases, mixed terms, and multiple queries (any match).

Always use curly braces for control structures, even single-line bodies. Use PHP 8 constructor property promotion; `public function __construct(public GitHub $github) { }`. Do not allow empty `__construct()` methods with zero parameters unless the constructor is private. Always use explicit return types and appropriate parameter types, e.g. `protected function isAccessible(User $user, ?string $path = null): bool`. Enum keys typically use TitleCase. Prefer PHPDoc over inline comments. Never use comments within the code itself unless the logic is exceptionally complex. Add useful array shape types where appropriate.

Laravel Herd serves the app at `https?://[kebab-case-project-dir].test`; use `get-absolute-url` for valid URLs. You must not run any commands to make the site available via HTTP(S). It is always available through Laravel Herd.

Every change must be programmatically tested. Write a new test or update an existing test, then run the affected tests to make sure they pass. Run the minimum tests needed; use `php artisan test --compact` with a specific filename or filter.

Inertia: pages live in `resources/js/pages` unless `vite.config.js` specifies otherwise. Use `Inertia::render()` instead of Blade views. Use v1/v2 features as appropriate and check docs first. Deferred props need an empty state with a pulsing or animated skeleton.

Laravel: use `php artisan make:` for new files; `php artisan make:class` for generic PHP classes. Pass `--no-interaction` to all Artisan commands and correct `--options`. Use typed Eloquent relationship methods, prefer relationships over raw queries/manual joins, and prefer `Model::query()` over `DB::`. Eager-load to prevent N+1; use query builder for very complex operations. New models need useful factories and seeders; check available `php artisan make:model` options with `list-artisan-commands` and ask if the user needs anything else. APIs default to versioned Eloquent API Resources unless existing conventions differ. Use Form Requests (rules and custom messages) for validation; follow sibling array/string rules. Use Laravel auth/authorization. Prefer named routes and `route()` for links. Queue time-consuming operations with `ShouldQueue`. Use `env()` only in config files; elsewhere use `config('app.name')`, not `env('APP_NAME')`. Test models via factories and check custom states. Follow project Faker conventions (`$this->faker` or `fake()`). Create tests with `php artisan make:test [options] {name}`; use `--unit` for unit tests; most should be feature tests. On `Illuminate\Foundation\ViteException: Unable to locate file in Vite manifest`, run `npm run build` or ask the user to run `npm run dev` or `composer run dev`.

Laravel 12 uses the streamlined structure: middleware are configured in `bootstrap/app.php` via `Application::configure()->withMiddleware()`, not `app/Http/Kernel.php`; register middleware, exceptions, and routing in `bootstrap/app.php`. Providers are in `bootstrap/providers.php`. `app\Console\Kernel.php` no longer exists; use `bootstrap/app.php` or `routes/console.php`. Commands in `app/Console/Commands/` are auto-available. When modifying a column, include all previously defined attributes or they will be dropped. Eager-loaded records can be limited natively, e.g. `$query->latest()->limit(10);`. Prefer model `casts()` over `$casts` when consistent with sibling models.

Wayfinder: import route functions from `@/actions/` (controllers) or `@/routes/` (named routes). Invokable example: `import StorePost from '@/actions/.../StorePostController'; StorePost()`. Route keys support `{post:slug}` via `show({ slug: "my-post" })`. Query merging: `show(1, { mergeQuery: { page: 2, sort: null } })`; `null` removes params. Inertia forms use `.form()` with `<Form>` or `form.submit(store())`.

Testing: This project uses Pest. Create tests with `php artisan make:test --pest {name}`. Run `php artisan test --compact` or `php artisan test --compact --filter=testName`. Do NOT delete tests without approval. Activate `pest-testing` for every testing-related task.

Pint: run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` before finalizing changes. Do not run `vendor/bin/pint --test --format agent`, simply run `vendor/bin/pint --format agent` to fix formatting.
